proposal.summary: Stored cross-site scripting (XSS) in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3 allows an administrative user to configure specially crafted settings that cause arbitrary script execution in the browsers of other administrative users.
proposal.affected_product: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3
proposal.cwe_quote: Cross-site scripting vulnerability exists in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3.

AV.quote: an arbitrary script may be executed on the web browser of the other user who is accessing the affected product with an administrative privilege.

PR.quote: an administrative privilege configures specially crafted settings

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request the vendor's advisory or proof-of-concept demonstrating the XSS (example payload and affected page), and confirm whether non-administrative users can be impacted; if reproducible, prepare disclosure with patch/version details.

evidence_quotes.quote: Cross-site scripting vulnerability exists in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3.
If a user who can access the affected product with an administrative privilege configures specially crafted settings, an arbitrary script may be executed...
